name: reverse-engineer-anything
title_zh: 拿到安装包就能拆出它怎么工作的逆向师
tagline_zh: 原生、托管、Electron、浏览器插件都认。不靠猜，用产物或运行时证据讲清功能、比版本、反编译、带重建。
tagline_en: Native, managed, Electron, or browser extension: explain features, diff versions, decompile, or guide.
desc_en: Reverse engineer native, managed, Electron/JavaScript, packaged, and browser applications with REA. Use shipped-artifact or approved runtime evidence to explain features, compare versions, decompile code, or guide a reconstruction. Skip REA for ordinary source-repository architecture analysis.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的源码分析，而是从已发布产物出发，用可核验证据反向还原行为，适合没有源码只有二进制的场景。
why_en: Evidence-first, not guesswork. Works from binaries you actually have, not source you wish for. Built for closed-world analysis.
limit_zh: 只处理已发布的二进制/打包产物，不接普通源码仓库的架构分析；需要你提供可运行的产物或运行时证据。
limit_en: Only for shipped/packaged artifacts, not source-repo architecture review. Needs a runnable sample or runtime evidence; no artifact, no work.
title_en: Reverse-engineer any shipped app from its artifact
